text: Kevin Carr, Interim Director, Client and Business Services, Parks, Forestry and Recreation, will provide an update and seek guidance from the Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee on Parks, Forestry and Recreation 's response to date and proposed next steps on the use of Indigenous-themed team names and logos in City facilities. Parks, Forestry and Recreation is committed to promoting a positive and inclusive experience in our facilities and protecting the dignity and well-being of Indigenous communities.
The Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee received the item for information.
